when: an operator views the stock list
then: each listed record presents batch number and serial number as separate fields, distinct from one another
architectural_notes: E2E: the stock list/index SPA page (client/) rendering the collection returned by the JSON list endpoint (app/routes/, renders_via: react) through service -> repository -> app/models, so it spans UI + service + real branch DB state. This is a separately built surface from the detail view (AC1); the list component maps each row's distinct batch_number/serial_number JSON fields into separate columns. Boundary stays JSON-only (NFR-F6-spa-json-boundary, R5); owner module is the SPA stock-list view over the app/routes/ list endpoint. No new cross-cutting concern.

independence.rationale: Distinct from AC1: this asserts the split fields appear in the list/index view, which is a separately built and separately breakable surface from the single-record detail view. The detail view could render batch and serial correctly while the list still shows only a combined value, and vice versa.
